messages:
Liam (AE): Silverline wants a quick POC for enterprise auth: SAML SSO, SCIM for users+groups, RBAC mapping, and tenant domain proofing. Also asked for Dedicated vs Private pricing + a short SLA. Need response by EOD Mon. Any obvious blockers?

Zoe (SE): We support SAML (IdP & SP initiations). Ask them for IdP metadata (XML or metadata url), preferred NameID format, and whether they need encrypted assertions. Also ask which attribute holds group memberships (e.g., groups, memberOf).

Hector (Security): From their questionnaire: mandatory SAML RSA-SHA256 signatures, SCIM over TLS1.2+, token-based SCIM auth (client_credentials), rotation every 90 days. They also asked about audit logs retention and admin separation. Legal will need SOC2 attestation and DPA for Private.

Mei (Eng): SCIM notes: we support full and incremental sync. Default rate limit 50 req/min; can be raised for Dedicated during POC. For group->role mapping we require a CSV mapping or JSON mapping file. Important: externalId must be stable. Example SCIM create user payload we accept:
```json
{
  "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName":"alice@silverline.com",
  "externalId":"u-12345"
}
```

Dana (Pricing): For POC we can provide a 30-day trial with a 25% usage credit. For Dedicated vs Private we need MAU and monthly token estimates. Can someone confirm numbers?

Liam (AE): Silverline estimates ~300 MAUs and ~1.2M tokens/mo during POC. They may scale to 1.5k MAUs if POC goes well. They also want clarity on domain locking (tenant-proof) for multi-domain org.

Zoe (SE): Tenant lock procedure: we issue a TXT token to add to DNS for the canonical domain; for multiple domains we give multiple tokens. We can also accept a signed email from a domain admin if DNS changes are not possible.

DeployBot: scim-connector/v3.0 deployed to staging  tests: scim create/update passed ✅

Hector (Security): Potential blocker: they require EU-only data residency for identity data. If confirmed, we need to propose EU Dedicated or EU Private. Legal prep time ~2 business days for DPA + region addendum.

Mei (Eng): Networking for Private: need outbound allowlist to control-plane (443), and a short cert exchange (we support mTLS). Also note that on-prem installs require a runbook for upgrades.

Dana (Pricing): Action: I'll draft a Dedicated vs Private comparison including committed vGPU hours and expected TPS. Will include POC credit. Need final MAU/token numbers to finalize.

Liam (AE): I'll ask customer for IdP metadata, a sample SAML response, and confirmation on EU residency. Scheduling customer call for Tue 11am PT.

Zoe (SE): I'll prepare a minimal SAML+SCIM quickstart doc and an RBAC mapping template (CSV).

Hector (Security): I'll prepare a short security blurb: SAML algos, SCIM TLS requirements, least-privilege SCIM token scopes, and audit retention windows.

Liam (AE): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the customer call. :thumbsup:
